summary: This Form 6-K by Ericsson discloses the utilization of an AGM mandate to retain and sell up to 70% of vested shares from long-term variable compensation programs (LTV I and II 2023) on Nasdaq Stockholm to cover tax and social security withholding. Up to 1,878,306 series B shares may be transferred from May 18, 2026, to the 2027 AGM at prevailing market prices. This is a routine share sale to satisfy withholding obligations, not a capital return or issuer tender offer. No material special situation is present; it is an ordinary administrative filing.
